H4600.def: a primitive root; to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle:--bruised, stuck, be pressed.

H4601.def: or Mamakath (Josh. 13:13) {mah-ak-awth'}; from «04600»; depression; Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman:--Maachah, Maachathites. See also «01038».

H4602.def: patrial from «04601»; a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah:--Maachathite.

H4603.def: a primitive root; properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously:--transgress, (commit, do a) trespass(-ing).

H4604.def: from «04603»; treachery, i.e. sin:--falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, × very.

H4605.def: from «05927»; properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.:-- above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on (X very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

H4606.def: (Aramaic) from «05954»; (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun):--going down.

H4607.def: from «05927»; a raising (of the hands):--lifting up.

H4608.def: from «05927»; an elevation, i.e. (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority:--ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs.

H4609.def: feminine of «04608»; elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grade-mark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms):--things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.

H4610.def: from «04608» and (the plural of) «06137»; Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert:--Maaleh- accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.

H4611.def: from «05953»; an act (good or bad):--doing, endeavour, invention, work.

H4612.def: from «05975»; (figuratively) a position:--attendance, office, place, state.

H4616.def: from «06030»; properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that:--because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), + lest, that, to.

H4617.def: from «06030»; a reply (favorable or contradictory):--answer, × himself.

H4618.et: from (06031), in the sense of depression or tilling
H4618.def: from «06031», in the sense of depression or tilling; a furrow:--+ acre, furrow.

H4621.et: from an unused root meaning to hew
H4621.def: from an usused root meaning to hew; an axe:--ax, tongs.

H4624.et: from an unused root meaning to repress
H4624.def: from an unused root meaning to repress; a parapet:--battlement.

H4625.def: from «06140»; a crook (in a road):--crooked thing.

H4626.def: from «06168»; a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space:--nakedness, proportion.

H4627.et: from (06148), in the sense of trading
H4627.def: from «06148», in the sense of trading; traffic; by implication, mercantile goods:--market, merchandise.

H4628.et: from (06150), in the sense of shading
H4628.def: or (feminine) maearabah {mah-ar-aw-baw'}; from «06150», in the sense of shading; the west (as a region of the evening sun):--west.

H4629.def: from «06168»; a nude place, i.e. a common:--meadows.

H4630.def: feminine of «04629»; an open spot:--army (from the margin).

H4631.def: from «05783»; a cavern (as dark):--cave, den, hole.

H4632.def: the same as «04631»; cave; Mearah, a place in Palestine:-- Mearah.

H4633.def: from «06186»; an arrangement, i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition:--preparation.

H4634.def: feminine of «04633»; an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array:--army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.

H4635.def: from «06186»; an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves):--row, shewbread.

H4636.et: from (06191), in the sense of stripping
H4636.def: from «06191», in the sense of stripping; bare:--naked.

H4638.def: a form of «04630»; waste; Maarath, a place in Palestine:--Maarath.

H4639.def: from «06213»; an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property:--act, art, + bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, × well, ((handy-, needle-, net-))work(ing, - manship), wrought.

H4641.def: or Maaseyahuw {mah-as-ay-yaw'-hoo}; from «04639» and «03050»; work of Jah; Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites:--Maaseiah.

H4643.def: or maasar {mah-as-ar'}; and (in plural) feminine maasrah {mah-as-raw'}; from «06240»; a tenth; especially a tithe:-- tenth (part), tithe(-ing).

H4644.def: of Egyptian origin: Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt:-- Memphis. Compare «05297».

H4646.def: from «05301»; a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring:--giving up.

H4647.def: from «05301»; the bellows (i.e. blower) of a forge:--bellows.

H4648.def: or Mphibosheth {mef-ee-bo'-sheth}; probably from «06284» and «01322»; dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal); Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites:--Mephibosheth.

H4649.def: a plural apparently from «05130»; wavings; Muppim, an Israelite:--Muppim. Compare «08206».

H4651.def: from «05307»; a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap:--flake, refuse.

H4654.def: or mappelah {map-pay-law'}; from «05307»; something fallen, i.e. a ruin:--ruin(-ous).

H4656.def: from «06426»; a terror, i.e. an idol:--idol.

H4657.et: from an unused root meaning to balance
H4657.def: from an unused root meaning to balance; a poising:--balancing.

H4658.def: from «05307»; fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase:--carcase, fall, ruin.

H4661.def: from «05310»; a smiter, i.e. a war club:--battle ax.

H4662.def: from «06485»; an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census:--appointed place, commandment, number.

H4663.def: the same as «04662»; assignment; Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem:--Miphkad.

H4664.def: from «06555»; a break (in the shore), i.e. a haven:--breach.

H4665.def: from «06561»; properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck:--neck.

H4666.def: from «06566»; an expansion:--that which...spreadest forth, spreading.

H4667.def: from «06585»; a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch:--buttocks.

H4668.def: from «06605»; an opener, i.e. a key:--key.

H4670.def: from the same as «06620»; a stretcher, i.e. a sill:--threshold.

H4671.def: or mowts (Zephaniah 2:2) {motes}; from «04160»; chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose):--chaff.

H4672.def: a primitive root; properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present:--+ be able, befall, being, catch, × certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), × have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-)on, meet (with), × occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

H4673.def: from «05324»; a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post:--garrison, station, place where...stood.

H4674.def: from «05324»; a station, i.e. military post:--mount.

H4675.def: or mitstsabah {mits-tsaw-baw'}; feminine of «04673»; a military guard:--army, garrison.

H4676.def: feminine (causatively) participle of «05324»; something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol:--garrison, (standing) image, pillar.

H4677.def: apparently from «04672» and «03050»; found of Jah; Metsobajah, a place in Palestine:--Mesobaite.

H4678.def: from «05324»; something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of a tree:--pillar, substance.

H4679.def: or mtsad {mets-awd'}; or (feminine) mtsadah {mets-aw-daw'}; from «06679»; a fastness (as a covert of ambush):--castle, fort, (strong) hold, munition.

H4680.def: a primitive root; to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out:--suck, wring (out).

H4681.def: active participle feminine of «04680»; drained; Motsah, a place in Palestine:--Mozah.

H4682.et: from (04711) in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness
H4682.def: from «04711» in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness; properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used):--unleaved (bread, cake), without leaven.

H4684.def: from «06670»; a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust):--neighing.

H4685.def: or (feminine) mtsowdah {mets-o-daw'}; or mtsodah {mets-o-daw'}; from «06679»; a net (for capturing animals or fishes):--also (by interchange for «04679») a fastness or (beseiging) tower:--bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare.

H4686.def: or (feminine) mtsuwdah {mets-oo-daw'}; or mtsudah {mets-oo-daw'}; for «04685»; a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness; --castle, defense, fort(-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.

H4687.def: from «06680»; a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law):--(which was) commanded(-ment), law, ordinance, precept.

H4688.def: or mtsolah {mets-o-law'}; also mtsuwlah {mets-oo-law'}; or mtsulah {mets-oo-law'}; from the same as «06683»; a deep place (of water or mud):--bottom, deep, depth.

H4689.def: from «06693»; a narrow place, i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability:--anguish, distress, straitness.

H4690.def: or matsuq {maw-tsook'}; from «06693»; something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop:--pillar, situate.

H4691.def: or mtsuqah {mets-oo-kaw'}; feminine of «04690»; narrowness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble:--anguish, distress.

H4692.def: or matsuwr {maw-tsoor'}; from «06696»; something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness:--besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.

H4693.et: the same as (04692) in the sense of a limit
H4693.def: the same as «04692» in the sense of a limit; Egypt (as the border of Palestine):--besieged places, defense, fortified.

H4694.def: or mtsurah {mets-oo-raw'}; feminine of «04692»; a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification:--fenced (city, fort, munition, strong hold.

H4696.et: from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous
H4696.def: from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous; the forehead (as open and prominent):--brow, forehead, + impudent.

H4697.def: from the same as «04696»; a shin-piece of armor (as prominent), only plural:--greaves.

H4698.def: from «06750»; a tinkler, i.e. a bell:--bell.
